decisions.description: Primary scenario (plan section 4.1, A-03 acceptance): consolidate 7 external-data vendors (128 plans), save at least $2,000,000,000 gross. Expected winning plan: plan_beacon_echo (remove_beacon + remove_echo), gross savings exactly $2,300,000,000, termination ~$90,000,000, migration ~$130,000,000, feasible and ranked first (V-4). The naive plan plan_naive (remove_apex + remove_cinder, greedy by gross savings) is infeasible because vendor_apex is the sole provider of the critical ds_corporate_linkage (V-3). Removing vendor_delta alone is infeasible: it breaks ctl_kyc_screening (V-5). Removing both vendor_cinder and vendor_echo together (each individually safe) loses ds_intent_signals entirely and breaks c_sales (V-7).

Secondary scenario (plan section 4.2, A-04 acceptance): remove the 8 workforce roles in one plan (plan_remove_eight_roles, no subset search), save at least $1,070,000 gross (sum of the 8 roles' annual_cost_usd). Strands exactly wf_financial_close (loses its only kn_warehouse_lineage holder, role_data_platform_lead) and wf_billing_recon (loses both owners, role_billing_ops_lead and role_billing_specialist, whose exception-path knowledge was never documented); infeasible against c_stranded (W-2). plan_remove_eight_roles_mitigated (reassign_owner to role_controller and role_finance_analyst, document_runbook, retain_capacity_temporarily) restores stranded_workflows == 0 and is conditionally feasible (W-4, W-5).
